champion.tips: KHA'ZIX TIPS AND TRICKS Kha’Zix is a strong early game champion. Try to skirmish and gank as much as you can in the early game to get you and your allies ahead. Kha’Zix is a strong 1v1 duelist if he can take down an isolated target. You can invade the enemy Jungler in the early game and try to set them behind. At levels 6, 11 and 16 you’ll be able to evolve your abilities. Generally, your first evolve will be your Q .
champion.builds: THE BEST KHA'ZIX BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kha'Zix Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Dark Harvest as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Coup de Grace and Triumph in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Opportunity. For your last 3 items, you should build Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 51.4% winrate over 13 511 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kha'Zix Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are First Strike as your keystone, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Youmuu's Ghostblade, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Opportunity as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 51.4% win rate over 5 086 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Profane Hydra as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Axiom Arc as a third item. You want to finish the build with Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Opportunity. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 54.1% win rate across 3 093 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kha'Zix Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Coup de Grace with Triumph as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Hubris as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Youmuu's Ghostblade as third item. The last 3 options are Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 54.4% win rate over 2 775 matches played. Situational Kha'Zix Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kha'Zix build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kha'Zix runes page.
